defects.verdict: CONFIRMED in API and source; the form copy was not viewed in a browser in prebake
defects.title: The agreement form says consent cannot complete until every participating member attests, while its own quorum field lets it complete with fewer
steps: Open /agreements/new as a Plan Systems admin
Read the box 'Explicit individual consent is mandatory' and the 'Consent quorum (optional)' hint
Create the agreement with Consent quorum 1 (the form's own field), open advice, record an advice round, consent, record test evidence
defects.observed: AgreementForm.tsx:285 says 'The agreement cannot complete its consent ceremony until every participating member has personally attested.' The quorum hint at :317 says 'A number: that many members.' With quorum 1, AGR-B92E54F1 completed consent at 1 of 6 participating members and is active; its detail page shows 'Consent progress 1 of 6' on an agreement in force.
defects.expected: One rule in one sentence: blank means every participating member, a number means that many. The mandatory-consent box should not contradict the field below it.
defects.evidence: POST /api/v1/agreements/93da1d11-08fd-41b4-82dc-652170509468/consent -> 201 auto ['consent->test']; GET /api/v1/agreements/93da1d11-08fd-41b4-82dc-652170509468 -> 200 status=active consent_summary {required:6, consented:1}

observations: Why the gate uses consent quorum 1: with the form's default (quorum blank) an agreement's consent stage waits on EVERY participating member. Plan Systems has six: Lena, qa-agent-gus and qa-agent-hal (agent-eval personas), and the seeded Rachel (MBR-PS-001), Brandon (MBR-PS-002) and Drew (MBR-PS-003), none of whom has a session in this pass. The seeded AGR-PS-ACT-001 'Plan Systems Pairing Charter' sits in consent at 2 of 6 for this reason. Lena used the form's own optional 'Consent quorum' field (1); every ceremony still ran (advice opened, advice round, consent, test started, test evidence, active). No refusal occurred, so nothing was filed for the default rule itself.

Two 'membership agreements' now exist in Plan Systems: the seeded AGR-PS-003 'Plan Systems Membership Agreement' (active, type policy, NO participation gate) and Lena's AGR-B92E54F1 'Plan Systems membership agreement (uxqa-p3)' (active, the ecosystem-membership gate). Mateo's consent gate should list only the second; /agreements shows both. Lanes judge whether that confuses anyone.
AGR-B92E54F1's detail shows 'Consent progress 1 of 6' and 'Participation gates: ecosystem' while it is in force. Mateo's and the probe's lanes read this page.

OmniOne has no agreement in force due for review within 14 days (window 2026-11-01..2026-11-15; nearest AGR-OMNI-001 on 2027-05-14). Oren's queue shows no review-due item, only register_agreement 'Weekly Standup Tracker Agreement' and attest_agreement 'OmniOne Facilitation Rota'. health-audit-and-review step (1) records 'none due' and creates nothing, as briefed. Review-due work this pass is Lena's AGR-PS-006.

Lena's queue before her lane (GET /me/next-steps as her, 10 items) already lists finish_review 'Remote Work and Async Collaboration Policy' (AGR-PS-006). It also lists close_advice and give_advice on the same seeded proposal 'Client Data Sovereignty Protocol', two register_agreement items, record_position, take_entry_quiz and start_orientation ('Walk through Plan Systems's orientation'). Her lane's 'without hunting' judgement starts from this list.

The OmniOne domain list (GET /api/v1/domains) returns 16 domains. 12 are archived 'Seed Library (uxqa-p0/p2 agent-eval ...)' leftovers from agent-eval teardown, and 4 are active. If /domains or the post form's domain picker shows archived ones, Ines and Joy will see that clutter. This is environment residue; nothing was filed.
No OmniOne or Plan Systems domain has a domain-participation agreement gate (no active agreement with scope 'domain'), so Ines's join step meets no gate.
notes: All four fixtures reached their target state; no lane step is affected by a refusal.

planSystemsGate persists after the pass: anyone who joins Plan Systems later meets the consent gate too. Ending it needs the agreement review ceremony (under_review -> sunset), so prebake left it in force.

Collaboration lane target: Plan Systems 'Systems Design Circle' (9e5f22ee-9c0e-5603-b439-9f3ff5010eb0). The probe's throwaway 'Probe link (uxqa-p3)' should use a different Plan Systems domain ('Governance Circle' 82dfe92a-47f3-5561-afd3-c61995f87827 or 'Core Operations (HQ)' ffeffb91-a3ff-5c50-b87f-f23ab27ee22f) so the two collaborations never share a target in Lena's queue.

Ines's domain: 'Regenerative Agriculture Circle' (8930348a-fc99-512a-8105-536d336af0e8): active, ungated, 3 participants, no lane persona among them, no steward named. Alternates: 'Governance Circle' and 'Newcomer Garden (uxqa-p1)'. 'Core Operations (SHUR)' holds Tess's e-bike ad, so Ines's domain page stays free of it.

Cross-ecosystem visibility check: Lena (not in OmniOne) reads the e-bike ad by id (200, public). Tess (not in Plan Systems) reads the ladder need by id (200, public). Plan Systems' ecosystem page opens for a signed-in non-member (200, visibility public, steward Lena Brightwater). The signed-out view was not checked in prebake.
